therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Nivolumab plus Relatlimab or Nivolumab plus Ipilimumab
therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: PD-1 and LAG-3 or PD-1 and CTLA-4
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Dual checkpoint inhibition to enhance T-cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Immune checkpoint blockade to restore anti-tumor T-cell responses
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Metastatic melanoma patients stratified by MHC-II expression
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in Activated GZMB+ CD8+T-cell Density Intratumorally

safety_signals: Adrenal insufficiency in nivolumab plus ipilimumab arm

dose_info.schedule: Day 1 of each cycle (28-day cycles for relatlimab, 21-day cycles for ipilimumab)

context.comparator: Nivolumab plus Ipilimumab vs Nivolumab plus Relatlimab
